           RANUNCULUS SCELERATUS

         Marsh Buttercup


Is more irritating than others of this botanical family, as seen in the
        skin symptoms.   Boring, gnawing pain   very marked.   Pemphigus  . Periodical complaints. Fainting with pain in
        stomach.



Head.--  Gnawing in one spot left of vertex. Frightful dreams
        about corpses, serpents, battles, etc. Fluent coryza, with sneezing and burning micturition.



Mouth.--  Teeth and gums sensitive.   Tongue
        mapped   denuded patches. Mouth sore and raw.   Burning and
        rawness of tongue  .



Abdomen.--  Sensation of a plug behind umbilicus.   Pain over region of liver, with sensation as if diarrhœa would set it  .
        Pressure as of a plug behind right false ribs; worse, deep inspiration.



Chest.--  Integument sensitive. Bruised pain and weakness in the
        chest every evening.   Sore burning behind xiphoid cartilage  .



Skin.--    Vesicular eruption, with
        tendency to form large blisters. Acrid exudation, which makes surrounding parts sore  .



Extremities.--    Boring pain  .
        Sudden burning sticking   in right toe  . Corns, with
        burning and soreness, especially when feet hang down. Gout in fingers and toes.



Dose.--  First to third potency.
